image.alt: A painted illustration of a Harappan-era farming village beside a river, blending into a map of the Indus and Sarasvatī river system across the Indian subcontinent.

phases.alt: An illustrated three-panel infographic showing the Pre-Harappan, Early Harappan, and Mature Harappan phases as increasingly organised settlements - from a farming village, to a fortified town, to a planned grid city.

bhirrana.alt: A photograph of the actual Bhirrana potsherd, showing an incised graffiti drawing of a dancing figure with one hand on the hip.

kunal.alt: An illustration of a Harappan-era metalworking scene: two ornate silver tiaras, a pile of colourful beads, copper arrowheads, and a craftsman working at a furnace outside mud-brick dwellings.

bricks.alt: An illustration of Harappan brick-makers at work, with inset diagrams showing the 1:2:4 brick ratio, header and stretcher brick courses, and a site-distribution map, over a view of a brick city street.

citadel.alt: An aerial illustration of the Mohenjo-daro Citadel: a raised platform with the sunken Great Bath, a pillared hall, and a granary, beside the gridded rooftops of the Lower Town and a river in the distance.

lowertown.alt: A street-level illustration of the Harappan Lower Town: a paved main street, houses with doorways and storage jars, a public well with people drawing water, and inset close-ups of a covered drain and an inspection sump.
